grid.expression: SELECT V.CODPROD, V.DESCRPROD, V.CODVOL, V.CODGRUPOPROD, V.DESCRGRUPOPROD, V.REFERENCIA, V.COMPLDESC, V.ESTOQUE, V.PLANEJADO_ESTOQUE, V.PEDIDO_ABERTO_ESTOQUE, V.PEDIDO_ABERTO_VENDA, V.AD_AGRUPADOR, V.ESTOQUE + V.PLANEJADO_ESTOQUE + V.PEDIDO_ABERTO_ESTOQUE - V.PEDIDO_ABERTO_VENDA AS SALDO, V.ESTOQUE /*+ V.PLANEJADO_ESTOQUE*/ + V.PEDIDO_ABERTO_ESTOQUE - V.PEDIDO_ABERTO_VENDA AS SALDOSEMPLANEJADO /*(SELECT SUM(AD.QTDPREV) - SUM((SELECT OBTEM_TOTAIS_MRP((SELECT MAX(M.NUMPS) FROM TPRMPS M WHERE TRUNC(M.DTINICMPS, 'MM') = TRUNC(AD.DTREF,'MM')),AD.CODPROD,0,'P') FROM DUAL)) - SUM(AD.QTDREDMET) + SUM((SELECT SALDO FROM (SELECT nvl(SUM(VGF.SALDO),0) AS SALDO FROM VGFSALDOMRP VGF WHERE VGF.CODPROD = AD.CODPROD AND VGF.DTREF < AD.DTREF) D)) FROM AD_TGFMET AD WHERE AD.CODPROD = V.CODPROD AND AD.DTREF <= :P_DATA) AS SALDOMETA*/ FROM(SELECT PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, PRO.CODGRUPOPROD, GRU.DESCRGRUPOPROD, PRO.REFERENCIA, PRO.COMPLDESC, PRO.AD_AGRUPADOR, SUM(NVL(EST.ESTOQUE,0)) AS ESTOQUE, NVL((SELECT SUM(IPA.QTDPRODUZIR) - SUM(NVL((SELECT SUM(I.QTDNEG) FROM TGFCAB C INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON (C.NUNOTA=I.NUNOTA) WHERE C.TIPMOV='F' AND C.IDIPROC= PROC.IDIPROC AND I.ATUALESTOQUE=1 AND I.CODPROD = IPA.CODPRODPA),0)) FROM TPRIPROC PROC INNER JOIN TPRIPA IPA ON (PROC.IDIPROC = IPA.IDIPROC) WHERE PROC.STATUSPROC IN ('A','P2') AND IPA.CODPRODPA = PRO.CODPROD AND NVL(PROC.DTPREVENT,TRUNC(PROC.DHINC)+ 7) <= :P_DATA),0) AS PLANEJADO_ESTOQUE, NVL((SELECT SUM(QTDPREV) FROM TGMMET WHERE DTREF = ADD_MONTHS(:P_DATA,-1) AND CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD),0) AS PEDIDO_ABERTO_ESTOQUE, NVL((SELECT SUM(QTDNEG-QTDENTREGUE) FROM TGFCAB CAB, TGFITE ITE WHERE CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.PENDENTE = 'S' AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' AND ITE.PENDENTE = 'S' AND CAB.CODTIPOPER <> 900 AND CAB.DTPREVENT <= :P_DATA),0) AS PEDIDO_ABERTO_VENDA FROM TGFPRO PRO LEFT JOIN TGFEST EST ON (PRO.CODPROD = EST.CODPROD AND EST.CODLOCAL = 109 AND EST.CODEMP = 1) INNER JOIN TGFGRU GRU ON PRO.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU.CODGRUPOPROD WHERE ( PRO.DESCRPROD LIKE '%' || UPPER(:P_DESCRPROD) || '%' OR :P_DESCRPROD IS NULL) AND (SUBSTR(PRO.CODGRUPOPROD,0,4) like SUBSTR(:P_CODGRUPO,0,4) OR :P_CODGRUPO IS NULL) AND PRO.USOPROD='V' AND PRO.ATIVO='S' AND ( NVL(PRO.AD_OBSOLETO,'N') = 'N' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TGFEST EST WHERE EST.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND EST.ESTOQUE > 0 AND EST.CODLOCAL =109)) GROUP BY PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, PRO.REFERENCIA, PRO.COMPLDESC, PRO.CODGRUPOPROD,GRU.DESCRGRUPOPROD,PRO.AD_AGRUPADOR) V ORDER BY PEDIDO_ABERTO_VENDA DESC,PLANEJADO_ESTOQUE DESC, DESCRPROD

grid.title: Pedidos em Aberto até a Previsão Entrega :P_DATA Clique 2 vezes para abrir Pedido
grid.expression: SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, SUM(QTDNEG-QTDENTREGUE) AS QTDNEG, CAB.DTNEG, CAB.DTPREVENT, TPV.DESCRTIPVENDA FROM TGFCAB CAB, TGFITE ITE, TGFTPV TPV, TGFPAR PAR WHERE CAB.NUNOTA= ITE.NUNOTA AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND CAB.CODTIPVENDA = TPV.CODTIPVENDA AND CAB.DHTIPVENDA = TPV.DHALTER AND CAB.PENDENTE = 'S' AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' AND ITE.PENDENTE = 'S' AND CAB.CODTIPOPER <> 900 AND CAB.DTPREVENT <= :P_DATA AND ITE.CODPROD = :A_CODPROD GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL,CAB.DTNEG, CAB.DTPREVENT, TPV.DESCRTIPVENDA order by CAB.DTPREVENT, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL

grid.title: Ordens de Produção em Andamento
grid.expression: SELECT IPA.IDIPROC,IPA.NROLOTE, IPA.QTDPRODUZIR-NVL((SELECT SUM(I.QTDNEG) FROM TGFCAB C INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON (C.NUNOTA=I.NUNOTA) WHERE C.TIPMOV='F' AND C.IDIPROC= PROC.IDIPROC AND I.ATUALESTOQUE=1 AND I.CODPROD = IPA.CODPRODPA),0) AS QTDPRODUZIR ,PROC.DTPREVENT FROM TPRIPROC PROC INNER JOIN TPRIPA IPA ON (PROC.IDIPROC = IPA.IDIPROC) WHERE PROC.STATUSPROC IN ('A','P2') AND IPA.CODPRODPA = :A_CODPROD
